plain: The physicist Edward Condon, who came to dismiss UFOs, may have been blackmailed into doing so, the theory goes: while he was being investigated for communist sympathies in the 1950s, an FBI field agent named Guy Hottel was quietly building a dossier of field reports on him. Michels puts this forward himself, without naming a source. If true, it would mean a leading scientific voice against UFOs was pressured by the government into that view.
